podcast.body: This album, released in 1987 by Jennifer Warnes (a former backup singer for Leonard Cohen), featured covers of Cohen's songs and became a significant hit, drawing unprecedented attention to Cohen himself. "In 1987, Jennifer Warren's, one of his former backup singers, released an album of Cohen covers called Famous Blue Raincoat. It became a big hit for her, drawing more attention to Cohen than he'd ever seen before in his life."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
